name: Configuration & Build
description: Project configuration, build tooling, and deployment settings. Includes TypeScript configuration, package dependencies, Vercel deployment config, and development documentation.

name: API Layer
description: HTTP request handlers for external integrations. Handles event checkout session creation, Stripe webhook processing, and payment event coordination.

name: UI Component Layer
description: React components for rendering user interface. Includes event page rendering, registration forms, dynamic section rendering, and checkout UI integration.

name: Business Logic & Data Layer
description: Core application logic for event data management, pricing calculations, and checkout processing. Contains event definitions, promo code resolution, pricing utilities, and checkout parameter building.

name: Integration Services Layer
description: Third-party service integrations and external APIs. Handles Stripe API configuration, calendar event generation (Google Calendar and iCal formats), and transactional email delivery via Resend.
